title: LingBot-Map
description: LingBot-Map (Robbyant, 2026): streaming 3D reconstruction, cameras and depth for a long image sequence frame by frame with a sliding-window cache. Apache-2.0 code and weights.
html:
LingBot-Map (Robbyant, 2026): streaming 3D reconstruction, cameras and depth for a long image sequence frame by frame with a sliding-window cache. Apache-2.0 code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

Speed and memory not measured for: lingbot-map.

Details
  • Paper: LingBot-Map: Geometric Context Transformer for Streaming 3D Reconstruction, ECCV 2026, 2026-04-15
  • Original code: https://github.com/Robbyant/lingbot-map at b9dd1b1
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/Robbyant/lingbot-map/blob/b9dd1b1/LICENSE.txt and https://huggingface.co/robbyant/lingbot-map (no licence field)
  • Training data: Per the README: a stage-1 bidirectional (VGGT-style) checkpoint, then streaming training; datasets are not listed
  • Options: long_side = 518 (>= 14), scale_frames = 8 (>= 1), window = 64 (>= 1)
  • Kernel libraries: fastbb, cudnn_hacc
  • Variants: lingbot-map
  • Outputs: depth, confidence, intrinsics, cam_to_world; kind: scale_invariant
  • Input size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): lingbot-map 3000x4000 (5.5 GiB peak allocated, 6.8 reserved)

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.002 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.02 and p99 <= 0.25 (absolute error of the output depth).

Limitations

  • Views are a sequence (a video): each view only sees the first scale_frames views and the views before it (older than window frames: their 6 special tokens only). At most 1024 views.
